messages:
dara_sec: Auditor requested a compact evidence bundle tying one RBAC change to git->CI->k8s audit->CloudTrail->KMS. Need artifacts + a 60s playback.
kyle_oncall: Scope to staging: single rolebinding change, one CI pipeline run. Artifacts: rolebinding-diff.patch, ci-apply-778.log, kube-audit-snippet.jsonl, cloudtrail-export.csv, kms-describe.json, mapping.csv, playback.mp4.
auditor_zoe: Staging replay is fine if you sanitize IDs. Include the exact queries/commands and a CSV mapping each artifact to SOC2/ISO control IDs (one-line rationale).
mira_platform: I will create an ephemeral SA and apply a rolebinding in namespace "staging-evidence". Will capture kubectl apply output and controller events, then tear down.
dara_sec: Paste the extraction queries you will include so I can add them to the README.
mira_platform: K8s audit extraction (parameterize namespace/name):
```bash
jq -c 'select(.objectRef.resource=="rolebindings" and .objectRef.namespace=="staging-evidence")' /var/log/kube-apiserver/audit.log | sed -n '1,60p'
```
CloudTrail/Splunk sample we'll include:
```splunk
index=aws_cloudtrail (eventName=PutRole* OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventName=AssumeRole) | table _time, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters
```
KMS commands (staging key):
```bash
aws kms describe-key --key-id <redacted> --profile staging
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id <redacted> --profile staging
```
kyle_oncall: CI tie: include COMMIT_SHA and PIPELINE_ID printed by the job and the exact kubectl apply line. Example lines will be attached.
packager-bot: Artifact uploaded: ci-apply-778.log (sanitized). Artifact uploaded: mapping.csv (draft).
dara_sec: Reminder: run infra/tools/scrub-ids.sh on all exports and list replacements in README. Replace ARNs, hostnames, and customer UUIDs with tokens.
auditor_zoe: Also include a one-paragraph timeline.txt (commit -> CI -> apply -> audit event -> CloudTrail event -> KMS check). That plus mapping.csv should be enough for initial review.
mira_platform: I'll prepare artifacts and schedule the rehearsal with @auditor_zoe tomorrow 11:30am PT. Targets: package by EOD today.
dara_sec: Thanks — I'll assemble and scrub. If anyone thinks a short policy snippet (who can approve rolebindings) is useful, drop it here.
kyle_oncall: I'll attach policy-snippet.json showing the CI role permissions.
auditor_zoe: Perfect. See you at rehearsal.
